assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic contributors to these symptoms.
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is medically necessary.
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is coded as CPT 93226.
The claim for CPT code 93226 has been denied.
The denial is based on reason code PR-204.
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
The patient has sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome (Z86.73).
The patient has a history of I49.5.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within ninety days of this notice.
Failure to submit an appeal within the specified timeframe may result in the forfeiture of appeal rights.
